scope: Bounded search of official Stanford/Hoover visitor, library, planning and athletics sources plus the public University Archives finding aid. This is not a complete campus search and not a claim that absent plans do not exist.

buildings.name: Hoover Tower

sources.supports: Rotunda, galleries, observation deck and 14th-floor carillon; no room geometry.
Lists 1967 basement and first-floor renovation drawings in boxes 41/42; no digitized drawing was obtained. Historical catalog entries cannot establish current layout.

buildings.decision: Exterior refinement only. Do not infer a multi-floor interior from floor count.

buildings.name: Cantor Arts Center

sources.supports: First and second floors, gallery numbers, lobby/courtyard/terraces, stairs and elevators.

buildings.verification: Cached PDF text retrieved. Official current and earlier plan downloads returned Cloudflare 403 in raw HTTP and normal headless Chrome; the screenshot tool supplied no image bytes. No current plan geometry was visually inspected. Details: stanford-cantor-reference.json.
buildings.decision: Do not construct walls until a current plan image is inspectable. The footprint and courtyard were verified, but they do not establish interior wall positions.

buildings.name: Stanford Stadium

sources.supports: Links gameday map and identifies accessible concourses and facilities.
Seating sections, outer circulation ring, tunnel A-H positions, skybox and service locations. Reviewed as a rendered page; no room subdivision or dimensional section.

buildings.decision: Supports a later circulation/concourse refinement; cannot establish press-box suite interiors or private room layouts.

buildings.name: Green Library

sources.supports: Space names and visitor information, no dimensional floor plan obtained.
Bing Wing floor uses and accessible routes; linked site-access map is not an interior floor plan.
East Wing level uses and wing connections, not wall geometry.

buildings.decision: Continue plan research before constructing rooms; named floors do not establish wall positions.

buildings.name: Main Quad

sources.supports: Public map and building search; Stanford Login offered for community information. No current usable interior drawing obtained.
Main Quad Exterior Guidelines address exterior treatment, not internal room layouts.

buildings.decision: Public campus outline and exterior guidelines are insufficient to invent rooms across individual Quad wings.
